insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,123,745 to $22,763,587, a 3.72x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (+1).
